title: Quick-Dense Moroccan Beef Mechoui
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan beef mechoui that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines mixed beef cuts in a sweet and spicy sauce, resulting in a deliciously dense and moist final product.

ingredients.name: mixed beef cuts (1.5 kg)
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of beef shanks, brisket, and chuck for optimal flavor and texture.

instructions: Rinse the mixed beef cuts and pat them dry with paper towels.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, honey, lemon juice, and crushed tomatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and make sure it's covered with the sauce.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the beef for 2 hours and 30 minutes, or until it's tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve the mechoui with couscous or crusty bread to soak up the flavorful sauce.
